orchestrations.name: Application-managed document retrieval
control_flow: Authenticate the caller and resolve tenant/document grants
Retrieve only permitted document chunks from a separately provisioned retrieval tier
Pass bounded context to the model and collect structured output
Validate citation identifiers against the authorized retrieval set
Return an answer or an explicit no-evidence result
orchestrations.state: Application owns document ingestion/index state, tool transcript and citation identifiers; retention is unresolved
orchestrations.permissions: Enforce tenant and document grants before retrieval and again when resolving citations; scope service IAM independently
orchestrations.failure_handling: Fail closed on authorization errors. Bound retries and timeouts. Do not invent citations or use unrelated documents.
orchestrations.behavior_difference: Ranking, chunking, file ingestion, citations and conversation state will differ from hosted file search; parity is unverified
required_tests: Verify citations resolve to permitted source documents
Measure retrieval/answer quality against an agreed dataset
Exercise empty, stale, timeout and duplicate-request cases
